from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, inspect
path = Path('days.py').resolve()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate_days', path)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
days = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(days)
for name in ('chart_day', 'detail_day', 'share_day'):
    projection = getattr(days, name)
    assert list(inspect.signature(projection).parameters) == ['timestamp', 'offset_minutes']
    assert projection('2027-01-01T18:45:00Z', 330) == '2027-01-02', name + ' must preserve exact positive-minute offsets'
    assert projection('2027-01-01T04:15:00Z', -480) == '2026-12-31', name + ' must preserve exact negative-minute offsets'
assert list(inspect.signature(days.audit_day).parameters) == ['timestamp']
assert days.audit_day('2027-01-01T18:45:00Z') == '2027-01-01', 'audit day must remain UTC'
for name, args in (('chart_day', ('2027-01-01T18:45:00', 330)), ('detail_day', ('2027-01-01T18:45:00', 330)), ('share_day', ('2027-01-01T18:45:00', 330)), ('audit_day', ('2027-01-01T18:45:00',))):
    try:
        getattr(days, name)(*args)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name + ' must reject naive timestamps')
print('shared user-date projections and UTC audit exception verified')
